item.title: CVE-2026-101862 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Monday 23 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | EUSurvey through 1.6, prior to commit 0669a36, contains a path traversal vulnerability in the survey import function that allows authenticated attackers with the Form Manager role to execute arbitrary code on the server. The POST /noform/management/importSurvey endpoint trusts archive entry names when SurveyExportHelper writes imported files through FileService, so a crafted survey archive can write a JSP file outside the survey storage directory into the application directory, where Tomcat executes it with the privileges of the EUSurvey process

item.title: CVE-2026-101863 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Monday 23 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | EUSurvey 1.5.5 through 1.6, prior to commit d5295d5, contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the POST /forms/bulkchange endpoint that allows any authenticated user to take over or delete other users' surveys. SurveyController accepts arbitrary survey IDs and privilege values, and BulkExecutor applies the requested access-right changes or deletion without checking whether the requester can manage those surveys, allowing an ordinary ROLE_USER account to grant itself full control of another user's survey, read its draft and results, edit the form, manage its invitations, or delete it.

item.title: CVE-2026-101864 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 9.2
item.description: Monday 23 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 9.2 | EUSurvey through 1.6, prior to commit a4161a9, contains a weak password recovery mechanism that allows attackers who obtain a still-valid password-reset link to take over accounts that use a local EUSurvey password. The /auth/reset/ flow checks only the age of a reset code and does not invalidate it after the password is changed, and issuing a newer link leaves earlier links active, so a used or superseded link remains valid for up to 24 hours from issuance and can be reused to set a new password, sign in as the affected user, and lock that user out.

item.title: CVE-2026-101866 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.8
item.description: Monday 23 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.8 | EUSurvey through 1.6, prior to commit 118facd, contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the public POST /runner/draft/runner endpoint that allows unauthenticated attackers to overwrite another participant's saved draft and obtain its private invitation token. The draft save handler in RunnerController and AnswerService loads an existing draft by invitation alone without checking that the submitted survey, participation group and invitation belong together, then replaces the draft's answers, reassigns it to the submitted survey, and returns a resume link containing the private invitation token.

item.title: CVE-2026-101867 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.6
item.description: Monday 23 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.6 | EUSurvey through 1.6, prior to commit edb5021, contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in the GET /settings/shareEdit/{shareId} and POST /settings/shares handlers that allows any authenticated user to read or modify another user's contact share. The ownership check in SettingsController denies access only when a condition is both true and false, so it never denies access, allowing an ordinary account without Contact Management privileges to read the names and email addresses in a share and to rename it, change its recipient or access mode, or replace its contacts.

item.title: CVE-2026-101868 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Monday 23 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | EUSurvey through 1.6, prior to commit 4bf95a3, contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the GET /preparepublishedcontribution/{id} endpoint that allows unauthenticated attackers to read private responses submitted to published surveys. The contribution PDF handler in ContributionController looks up a response by its sequential database ID and skips the normal response access checks, so attackers can enumerate IDs to retrieve other respondents' answers, including free-text answers that may contain personal data, across surveys.

item.title: CVE-2026-101869 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Monday 23 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | EUSurvey 1.4.4.6738 through 1.6, prior to commit de1145c, contains an SQL injection vulnerability in the public results page GET /publication/{shortname} that allows unauthenticated attackers to infer non-public response data. ReportingService builds a SQL column expression from part of a user-supplied filter parameter name and inserts it directly into the query, so a visitor to any survey that publishes its results can inject boolean conditions and use the presence or absence of public result rows to infer private reporting data, including response data and respondent metadata from other surveys.

item.title: CVE-2026-101870 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Monday 23 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | EUSurvey through 1.6, prior to commit de1145c, contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the public POST /editcontribution/{code} endpoint that allows unauthenticated attackers to overwrite another respondent's submitted answers. The handler in ContributionController selects the survey and answer set from body parameters by numeric contribution ID and never checks that the private edit code in the URL matches that contribution, so an attacker who knows a contribution ID can replace its saved answers without the respondent's edit link.

item.title: CVE-2026-101871 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Monday 23 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | EUSurvey 1.5.2 through 1.6, prior to commit ffd5da7, contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the public POST /runner/delphiUpdate endpoint that allows unauthenticated attackers to submit responses to Delphi surveys after the owner has closed them. DelphiController checks only that the survey exists and is a Delphi survey and skips the closure check enforced by the normal survey page, so an attacker who knows the survey and question IDs can create new responses that remain in the survey's results.

item.title: CVE-2026-101872 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1
item.description: Monday 23 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1 | EUSurvey through 1.6, prior to commit 4bf95a3, contains a blind SQL injection vulnerability in the GET /dashboard/surveys endpoint that allows authenticated attackers with the Form Manager role to infer data from the main application database. SurveyService inserts unrecognized sort values directly into the ORDER BY clause of a native query, so attackers can supply SQL expressions and use response timing to infer any data readable by the application's database account, including data outside the surveys listed on their dashboard.

item.title: CVE-2026-101873 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3
item.description: Monday 23 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3 | EUSurvey 1.5.2 through 1.6, prior to commit bb7432c, contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in Delphi survey explanations that allows survey participants to execute arbitrary JavaScript in other users' browsers. Explanations submitted to POST /runner/delphiUpdate are stored by AnswerExplanationService without sanitization and rendered as HTML in delphiAnswersTable.jsp, so an injected event handler runs in the EUSurvey origin with the session of any participant or survey manager who views the answers table.

item.title: CVE-2026-101874 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3
item.description: Monday 23 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3 | EUSurvey through 1.6, prior to commit 6db6147, contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in the GET /exports/checkNew endpoint that allows authenticated attackers to read the names of other users' finished exports and suppress their notifications. ExportsController trusts a user ID supplied by the browser without checking it against the authenticated session, and ExportService marks every export it returns as notified, so the owner never receives the notice that their export is ready.

item.title: CVE-2026-101876 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3
item.description: Monday 23 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3 | EUSurvey through 1.6, prior to commit 03cc974, contains a blind server-side request forgery vulnerability in PDF export that allows authenticated attackers with the Form Manager role to make the server send HTTP or HTTPS requests to internal services. Question titles saved through POST /{shortname}/management/edit are rendered as raw markup in runnercontentinnerpdf.jsp, and the PDFRenderer resource loader fetches referenced images without checking whether the destination is on an internal network when a response is exported as a PDF.

item.title: CVE-2026-101877 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3
item.description: Monday 23 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3 | EUSurvey through 1.6, prior to commit 4ff1ba0, contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the GET /pdf/survey/{surveyId} endpoint that allows attackers holding a valid invitation for one survey to download a different survey's restricted questionnaire PDF without signing in. PDFController checks that the supplied invitation and participation group are active but not that they belong to the requested survey, exposing questions intended only for invited respondents of any published survey that allows PDF access.

item.title: CVE-2026-122090 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.4
item.description: Monday 23 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.4 | Pelican 4.12.0 contains an OS command injection vulnerability in pelican-import. An attacker-controlled wp:post_name from a WordPress XML export is used in an output filename that is interpolated into a Pandoc command passed to subprocess.call with shell=True. On POSIX systems, command substitution in the slug is evaluated when a user imports the crafted export.

item.title: CVE-2026-130166 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.7
item.description: Monday 23 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.7 | n8n is an open source workflow automation platform. Prior to 1.123.90 and 2.14.0, the invitation acceptance endpoint accepts inviter and invitee user IDs without a signed invitation token, allowing any preexisting member to take over a pending new user account. A member with permission to list users can read the ID of a pending account and set its password without authentication, then log in as that user, including as an admin when the invitation has the admin role. Exploitation requires an invitation that has not been accepted yet. This issue is fixed in versions 1.123.90 and 2.14.0.

item.title: CVE-2026-130167 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.5
item.description: Monday 23 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.5 | n8n is an open source workflow automation platform. Prior to 2.47.6, 2.48.3, and 3.2.2, the password reset link and role change operations do not protect the instance owner account from users with a custom instance role. A user whose custom instance role includes user management permissions can obtain a password reset link for the owner and take over the owner account, or change the owner's role, gaining full control of the instance. Exploitation requires the custom roles feature and a custom instance role with user management permissions. This issue is fixed in versions 2.47.6, 2.48.3, and 3.2.2.

item.title: CVE-2026-130169 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 10.0
item.description: Monday 23 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 10.0 | AutoGPT is a workflow automation platform for creating, deploying, and managing continuous artificial intelligence agents. In versions 0.6.26 through 0.7.4, AutoGPT Platform ships a publicly known, hardcoded default JWT verification key in backend/.env.default and autogpt_platform/.env.default. Because HS256 is symmetric, anyone who knows the secret can forge valid JWTs for any user or for the admin role, bypassing authentication and authorization without user interaction. This issue is fixed in version 0.8.0.

item.title: CVE-2026-132257 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 8.2
item.description: Monday 23 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 8.2 | AutoGPT is a workflow automation platform for creating, deploying, and managing continuous artificial intelligence agents. From versions 0.6.23 and above, before 0.8.0, AutoGPT Platform ships a hardcoded default Fernet encryption key in backend/.env.default, which encrypts every user's OAuth tokens, API keys, and integration credentials in the User.integrations column. Anyone with read access to the database of a deployment using the default key can decrypt the stored credentials. This issue is fixed in version 0.8.0.

item.title: CVE-2026-133455 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 6.5
item.description: Monday 23 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 6.5 | AutoGPT is a workflow automation platform for creating, deploying, and managing continuous artificial intelligence agents. Prior to 0.9.0, nested tools invoked by OrchestratorBlock bypass the main execution queue and are charged only after succeeding, but post-run billing still refunds a failed tool's catalogue price as a presumed pre-flight charge. Any authenticated customer can trigger failed nested calls to add uncharged credits to their balance and fund later executions using the operator's credentials. This issue is fixed in version 0.9.0.

item.title: CVE-2026-133930 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 5.3
item.description: Monday 23 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 5.3 | A pooled-buffer lifetime error in Elasticsearch ES|QL Arrow response formatting can disclose data from other users' concurrent requests. An authenticated user with read access to an index who requests Arrow output containing an affected column type can receive data from indices they are not authorized to access. A temporary block can be released to a shared memory pool before deferred response writers finish using it, allowing concurrent requests to reuse the same memory. The attacker cannot select which concurrent data is disclosed.

item.title: CVE-2026-134020 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 6.5
item.description: Monday 23 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 6.5 | OpenEMR is a free and open source electronic health records and medical practice management application. Prior to 8.5.0, the staff-facing portal endpoints GET api/onsiteactivityviews and GET api/onsiteactivityview/{id}, mapped to OnsiteActivityView.Query and OnsiteActivityView.Read with p_acl = p_none in portal/patient/_app_config.php, are handled without an authorization check for an authenticated staff session whose bootstrap_pid is empty. portal/patient/_machine_config.php admits that authenticated staff session, and portal/patient/fwk/libs/verysimple/Phreeze/GenericRouter.php applies the route ACL only when bootstrap_pid is nonempty, so the staff request bypasses the p_none check. OnsiteActivityViewController::Query() returns records without patient scoping, and OnsiteActivityViewController::Read() loads a record by identifier without checking ACL or ownership; OnsiteActivityViewReporter::GetCustomQuery() joins portal activity to patient demographics and includes names, dates of birth, addresses, and Social Security numbers. Any authenticated staff account, including one without the patients/demo permission, can therefore read sensitive demographics for patients represented by an existing onsite_portal_activity row; at least one such row must exist for the endpoint to return patient data. This issue is fixed in version 8.5.0.

item.title: CVE-2026-134021 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 7.5
item.description: Monday 23 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 7.5 | TastyIgniter is an open-source online ordering, table reservation, and restaurant management system. Prior to 4.3.1, the Mollie payment notification handler in src/Payments/Mollie.php, processNotifyUrl(), uses a payment ID supplied with the notification to retrieve a paid transaction but does not verify that the transaction's order reference matches the order identified by the notification URL or that the transaction amount matches the order total. An ordinary customer can use a paid Mollie transaction from one order to cause a different, higher-value order to be marked paid without paying its full price. The endpoint is intentionally unauthenticated so Mollie's servers can reach it, and the request's order hash alone does not bind the fetched payment to that order. This issue is fixed in version 4.3.1.

item.title: CVE-2026-134022 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 3.7
item.description: Monday 23 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 3.7 | TastyIgniter is an open-source online ordering, table reservation, and restaurant management system. Prior to 4.2.0, the User extension’s onRequestResetPassword() handler in src/Http/Controllers/Login.php calls resetPassword() and mailSendResetPasswordRequest() only when an account matches. The resulting database write and reset-email send take longer than the nonexistent-account path despite the endpoint returning the same response, allowing timing measurements against a production deployment using a synchronous queue and real SMTP transport to disclose valid staff or customer email addresses. The advisory’s local log-mailer test showed no measurable timing difference, so the signal depends on mail configuration and is useful for follow-on phishing or credential stuffing rather than direct account access. This issue is fixed in version 4.2.0.

item.title: CVE-2026-134023 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 7.4
item.description: Monday 23 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 7.4 | TastyIgniter is an open-source online ordering, table reservation, and restaurant management system. Prior to 4.2.0, checkResetPasswordCode() in src/Auth/Models/User.php compares a submitted reset code with the stored 42-character token using a normal string comparison, which can return after the first differing byte instead of taking constant time. The password-reset flow exposes this comparison to remote requests, but the endpoint is rate-limited to six requests per minute per IP, and the advisory reports no live exploit or practical token-recovery demonstration. Recovering a high-entropy reset code through the constrained timing signal could permit an unauthorized password reset. This issue is fixed in version 4.2.0.

item.title: CVE-2026-134024 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 6.8
item.description: Monday 23 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 6.8 | TastyIgniter is an open-source online ordering, table reservation, and restaurant management system. Prior to 4.4.4, addFromUrl() in src/Flame/Database/Attach/Media.php performs an outbound HTTP request to a caller-supplied URL and stores the response without validating the URL scheme or destination, which could enable server-side request forgery if a reachable feature passes attacker-controlled URLs to the method. The maintainer reports that no shipped first-party feature calls this method and that it is currently unreachable through product functionality, so no current attack path or impact was identified. This issue is fixed in version 4.4.4.

item.title: CVE-2026-135415 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 2.1
item.description: Monday 23 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 2.1 | A flaw has been found in MiniMax up to 0.7.2. Affected is the function authorizedLocalScript of the file bash-checker.ts. item.title: CVE-2026-135418 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 2.1
item.description: Monday 23 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 2.1 | A vulnerability was found in jprocms up to 1.7.7.
